_설명: 천일문 3권 워크북 Chapter 11 일치와 화법의 Chapter Test를 변형한 것. 심화 11과 일치와 화법 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: 부분을 나타내는 말(half of, a third of…)의 수일치
a number of(복수) vs. the number of(단수)
시제 일치의 예외: 불변의 진리·현재의 습관

questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • Ten kilometers ____(A)____ a long distance for me to run.
• Badminton and tennis ____(B)____ popular racket sports.

choices.text: is — is
is — are
are — are
are — is
was — is

questions.point_label: 부분을 나타내는 말은 of 뒤 명사에 맞춘다
questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: Some of us [[are]] afraid of heights.
All of the shoes [[look]] new on the shelf.
Most of the houses [[were]] recently painted.
One third of the cake [[were]] eaten by Mina.
About eighty percent of the earth’s surface [[is]] covered with water.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
body: → The teacher said that practice ________ perfect.

choices.text: make
makes
made
would made
has made

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
body: 아무도 그녀가 유명한 작가가 될 거라고 생각하지 않았다.
→ Nobody thought that she ________ a famous writer.

choices.text: becomes
became
will become
would become
had become

questions.prompt: 다음 문장을 간접 화법으로 바르게 전환한 것을 고르세요.
body: He said to me, “Where can I buy a subway ticket here?”

choices.text: He asked me where I can buy a subway ticket here.
He asked me where he can buy a subway ticket here.
He asked me where I could buy a subway ticket there.
He asked me where he could buy a subway ticket there.
He asked me where could he buy a subway ticket there.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: Everyone have to return the book after reading it.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: Half of my teammates practices basketball in the gym.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 문장의 화법 전환이 바르게 된 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: Mina said, “I have a lot of work now.” → Mina said she has a lot of work then.
Sora said to him, “What did you buy yesterday?” → Sora asked him what he had bought yesterday.
The tourist said to me, “Can you speak Korean?” → The tourist asked me if I can speak Korean.
Emma said to her brother, “Bring me some water.” → Emma asked her brother to bring you some water.
He said to me with confidence, “I can repair this bike.” → He told me with confidence that he could repair that bike.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 야생 호랑이의 수가 해마다 줄고 있다. (number, wild tigers, be, decrease)
questions.answer: The number of wild tigers is decreasing

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: Each desk have a small lamp.
Taking care of plants require patience.
Every player are gathered on the field.
Some people believe that aliens actually exist.
The elderly enjoys walking in the park in the morning.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장을 주어진 단어를 사용하여 간접화법으로 바꿔 쓰세요.
body: He said to me, “I will visit the museum tomorrow.” (that, next)
questions.answer: He told me that he would visit the museum the next day

questions.prompt: 다음 문장을 주어진 단어를 사용하여 간접화법으로 바꿔 쓰세요.
body: She said to me, “Drink enough water every day.” (advise)
questions.answer: She advised me to drink enough water every day

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 것끼리 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: ⓐ I think that he started the rumor.
ⓑ Forty minutes is enough to finish the test.
ⓒ Mathematics are a useful subject in daily life.
ⓓ They were taught that the sun rose in the east.
ⓔ A number of students are waiting for the bus.
ⓕ I knew that Canberra is the capital of Australia.
